purpose: Document separate English/local-language searches, first-party local registry/cadastre evidence, and bounded anonymous geometry discovery.
assessment: ATR/BPN BHUMI documentation confirms a national interactive map with a bidang-tanah layer, but no query or geometry response was inspected at the unchanged Balung locator. A Jember office profile surfaced on a non-government .com domain; its official first-party status was not independently established. City/local registration custody and exact-point coverage remain unconfirmed. No full parcel polygons or owner/address data were retained.
registryAssessment: The public BHUMI help is national in scope. A Jember office profile and official-domain staff document were found, but neither provides a verified first-party, Balung-specific land-registry/map service or exact-point service coverage. The local .com page was not relied on as authoritative. This does not prove the local registry is absent.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI help documents interactive map layers including bidang tanah and coordinate/parcel search. National viewer documentation alone does not prove that the Jember land office or Balung WUP area is covered by an anonymous geometry service.
